post.title: Earthquake Home Retrofit Seattle WA — SDCI's Prescriptive Plan Set, Cripple Walls & Foundation Bolting
post.description: A homeowner's guide to a voluntary earthquake retrofit in Seattle: what SDCI's Earthquake Home Retrofit Permit covers, the eligibility questions on Sheet S0, how the anchor-brace-connect work is done in a crawlspace or basement, when you need an engineer instead, and how to verify a contractor.
